en: The letters zāl, ze and zhe do not join to the letter after them and have only two shapes. The letter zā joins and has four shapes. Put each shape in the right basket.

fa: به قصه گوش کن و با آن بخوان. بعد به سوال‌ها جواب بده.
en: Listen to the story and read along with it. Then answer the questions.

fa: هر حرف را با تصویری جوره کن که نامش با آن حرف شروع می‌شود.
en: Match each letter with a picture whose name starts with that letter.
What did Narges give the cat?

fa: نه. نرگس به پشک نان داد.
en: No. Narges gave the cat bread.

fa: او نهال را در باغ می‌کارد.
en: He plants the sapling in the garden.

fa: نوید هر روز به نهال آب می‌دهد.
en: Nawid waters the sapling every day.

fa: نوید سیب را با دوستانش می‌خورد.

What did Nawid give the sapling?

fa: نه. نوید به نهال آب داد.

What fruit does the tree have?
On the way she sees a cat.

What did Narges see on the way?

fa: حالا به آخر کلمه گوش کن. ماهی: ما، هی. بخش آخر را بگیر.
en: Now listen to the end of the word. Māhi (fish): mā, hi. Catch the last syllable.
Joy (stream). The water is in the stream.

fa: حوض. حوض پر از آب است.
en: Hawz (pool). The pool is full of water.
Maktab (school). I am going to school.
Gandom (wheat). Bread is made from wheat.
Khorus (rooster). The rooster crows in the morning.
Setāra (star). The star is in the sky.
Dokhtar (girl). The girl is reading a book.
Bacha (boy). The boy is reading a book.
